SCI model: T8 moderate contusion SCI; laminectomy-only sham; C57BL/6; isoflurane
Anatomical sampling: Rostral / impact / caudal 0.4-cm spinal cord segments
Biological/available replicate unit: Array (each SCI replicate pooled tissue from 4 mice; 12 mice per injury time point). Sham/naive pooling not established.
Technical/subsample structure: None (bulk); 6 naive arrays included in RMA/QC but not used as SCI-sham comparators
Primary role: Temporal + regional tissue-level respiratory program characterization (impact-site primary pattern)

Modality: Single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA), time-course cohort of Tabulae Paralytica
SCI model: T10 mid-thoracic crush SCI (source study n=3 mice/condition)
Biological/available replicate unit: Library (= biological replicate); library-level pseudobulk. Exact animal-ID to deposited-library-ID mapping unavailable.
n: 20 libraries (UI3, 1d3, 4d3, 7d2, 14d3, 1m3, 2m3); 151,712 nuclei in selected longitudinal cohort; 115,475 in the four analyzed populations; 77 library x celltype pseudobulk
Technical/subsample structure: Nuclei are not replicates; 77 = 80 - 3 absent microglia combinations
Primary role: Cell-type-resolved respiratory program validation (4 cell types)
Main limitation: Library-level pseudobulk; animal/library mapping unavailable; small n per condition

Modality: 2D spatial transcriptomics (10x Visium, spatial component of Tabulae Paralytica)
SCI model: T10 mid-thoracic crush SCI (same injury model as snRNA component)
Biological/available replicate unit: Biological sample (= replicate; 4 tissue sections per sample)
n: 9 biological samples (3 per condition); 36 sections; 33,941 spots
Technical/subsample structure: Sections and spots are spatial subsamples, not biological replicates
Primary role: Spatially resolved tissue-level respiratory program activity (7d and 2m)
Main limitation: No spot-level anatomical region annotations in processed metadata

SCI model: Severe contusion-compression SCI; FEJOTA mouse clip 8 g closing force x exactly 1 min, extradural after laminectomy, L1/L3 lumbar level; 30 dpi
Anatomical sampling: SCI: Above / Epicenter / Below 3-mm segments; UI: whole corresponding 9-mm segment (T11-S1)
Biological/available replicate unit: Animal (4 SCI animals, each contributing 3 regions - repeated measures; 4 uninjured animals)
n: 16 samples (4 SCI animals x 3 regions + 4 UI)
Technical/subsample structure: Region = repeated measure within animal; UI is a single whole 9-mm segment (not region-matched)
Main limitation: UI not region-matched to SCI 3-mm segments; regional pattern cannot be fully attributed to SCI
